Company and Site Assistant Job at Elkins Marine Training International Nigeria (EMTIN)




        
    

        
        Elkins Marine Training International Nigeria (EMTIN) is the official and number one training school and consultant for governments,the maritime industry, oil and gas sector,shipping industry,offshore and onshore operators in Africa.

We train, consult and provide solutions for corporate and private clients. Elkins was the first approved Maritime school in Nigeria quickly becoming the most reputable and biggest maritime training school in Africa.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Company and Site Assistant 

Job Location: Imo

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	You are applying to be a helper and assistant alongside the senior team.
	You can also learn and progress in the company based on how quickly you learn.
	This role is strictly for someone who is committed and ready to work in an international company and grow in their position.
	We have several roles for: entry level, mid level and senior level.
	You must have basic communication, time management, basic understanding of computer and tech is minimum requirement.
	Do not apply if you lack values and lack the most basic skills. You will be tested to prove your ability.
	Do not apply if you do not have any valid i.d. or if you not have a fixed accommodation. We need stable and mature candidates only.


Salary
N80,000 - N130,000 / month.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send an Introduction about yourself, and CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Business Development Associate",
  "description": "Genius Brand and Media Enterprises - Our client is an innovative and fast-growing LegalTech company building a technology-driven ecosystem that provides solutions that improve legal operations, professional opportunities, and access to legal services.

They are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:&nbsp;

Job Position:&nbsp;Business Development Associate

Job Location: Jabi, Abuja (FCT)&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry:&nbsp;Legal Technology / Technology

About the Role


	As part of its growth and market expansion, our client is seeking a driven, commercially minded, and results-oriented Business Development Officer to support customer acquisition, revenue growth, market penetration and strategic partnerships.
	The successful candidate will identify new business opportunities, generate and qualify leads, conduct product presentations, build relationships with decision-makers and convert qualified prospects into customers and strategic partners.
	This is a hands-on, target-driven role suited to someone who enjoys opening new doors, building relationships and turning opportunities into measurable business results.


Key Responsibilities
The Business Development Officer will:


	Identify and pursue new business and revenue opportunities.
	Generate, qualify, and manage leads across target customer segments.
	Drive the acquisition of lawyers, law firms, businesses, and other relevant users of the company&#39;s solutions.
	Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective customers and partners.
	Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and sales meetings.
	Develop relationships with business owners, executives, lawyers, law firm partners, and other decision-makers.
	Identify and pursue strategic partnerships with professional associations, business organizations, startup communities, and other relevant institutions.
	Prepare proposals, presentations, and business development materials.
	Manage prospects from initial engagement through follow-up, negotiation, and conversion.

	Identify and pursue new business and revenue opportunities.

	Drive the acquisition of lawyers, law firms, businesses, and other relevant users of the company's solutions.

	Develop relationships with business owners, executives, lawyers, law firm partners, and other decision-makers.

	Gather customer feedback and market intelligence to support commercial strategy.
	Prepare periodic business development and sales reports.
	Meet agreed customer acquisition, partnership, and revenue targets.


Target Market:
The successful candidate will primarily develop opportunities across:


	Legal Professionals: Individual lawyers, law firms and other professionals within the legal ecosystem.

	Strategic Partners: Professional associations, business organisations, chambers of commerce, startup communities, accelerators and other institutions capable of supporting the company's growth.

	A Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Law, Economics, Communications or a related discipline.

	Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
	Strong negotiation and relationship-management abilities.

	Most importantly, we want someone who can identify opportunities, open doors and convert relationships into customers, partnerships and revenue.

        ABNL Limited was incorporated in 1992 as an Oil and Gas servicing company with a vision to provide professional engineering and technical services to the Oil and Gas exploration and production companies in Nigeria and the West African sub-region. Since its incorporation, the company has grown in leaps and bounds, expanding its business horizon, but still within the Oil and Gas sector.
     

            
    



ABNL is a 100% owned indigenous firm, with a shareholding in excess of 100 million Naira. Its' directors are individuals of proven integrity, who over the years have acquired the requisite experience in the Oil and Gas business, as well as in the banking and finance sector. The integrity of the directors and the staff of the company have been a priceless contributive factor in the growth and wellbeing of the company.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Operations - Field Operator I 

Job Location: Yoho Platform, Akwa Ibom 
Employment Type: Contract

Main Functions


	Operate equipment and wells by applying operating and safety procedures and guidelines to meet daily operational plan, reduce equipment failure and efficient resources administration


Tasks and Responsibilities


	Responsible to implement on daily work objectives, housekeeping, safety, health, environmental and security
	Active participation on daily toolbox meetings and regular, reported safety meetings
	Identify and implement corrective and optimization actions by the continuous surveillance of wells and equipment to ensure reliable, efficient and safe operational conditions
	Function as Equipment Care Technician, and routinely use Maintenance skills in performing simple maintenance activities
	Report when the alarm, emergency or emergency shutdown system is out of service
	Provide detailed, clear and accurate information when changing shift, to guarantee that unit conditions are updated and ensure operations continuity
	Coordinate, control and monitor maintenance jobs according with the corrective, predictive and preventive planning
	Report continuously in the log book all relevant operational events and abnormal situations or deviation occurred in the work area, equipment or personnel
	Take samples of products for laboratory analysis and execute field laboratory tests
	Active participation on emergency response activities • Report incidents internally and escalate awareness as per the Incident Reporting Guidelines
	Ensure that Operations Shift Supervisor is informed and consulted about operations activities
	Ensure good communication across the work team so that issues / actions can be adequately addressed
	Provide the basic facts concerning well producing problems, current production rates, and current condition of the well 
	Ensure that the well problem diagnostics are thorough and complete before requesting Well Work intervention operations
	Ensure that the wellhead and well surface equipment are maintained and are in good working order prior to Wellwork operations taking over responsibility for the well for intervention operations
	Provide assistance and support to the ongoing Wellwork operations as needed


Skills and Qualifications


	Completed secondary education and worked previously as a Field Technician.
	Good communications (oral & written)
	High standard of Safety, Health, Environment aptitude and cultivates the same in others.
	Understanding of pipeline operations
	Understanding of safety and operations management tools and processes
	Understanding of Emergency Preparedness Procedures
	Understanding of Project Philosophy and Design Specifications
	Understanding of relevant regulations • Understanding of relevant commercial agreements

Radiographer Job at Open Hospital Limited




        
    

        
        Open Hospital Limited - Your health is our priority. Your comfort is our commitment. Quality Healthcare You Can Trust. Compassion You Can Feel. A privately owned healthcare facility under the Open Health Foundation, providing accessible, patient centered medical services for individuals and families in Abuja, Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Radiographer 

Job Location: Kubwa, Abuja (FCT)

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a qualified and skilled Radiographer to join our healthcare team.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for performing diagnostic imaging examinations, ensuring patient safety during imaging procedures, and producing high-quality images to assist physicians in accurate diagnosis and treatment.


Key Responsibilities


	Perform diagnostic imaging procedures such as X-ray imaging, ultrasound scans where applicable.
	Prepare patients for imaging procedures and explain processes to ensure comfort and cooperation.
	Position patients correctly to obtain accurate diagnostic images.
	Operate and maintain radiographic equipment safely and efficiently.
	Ensure strict adherence to radiation safety standards to protect patients, staff, and self.
	Review images for quality and ensure they are suitable for diagnostic interpretation.
	Work closely with radiologists and other healthcare professionals to support patient diagnosis and care.


Requirements


	Degree in Radiography / Medical Imaging.
	Valid practicing license from the Radiographers Registration Board of Nigeria (RRBN).
	Strong knowledge of diagnostic imaging procedures and radiation safety.
	Good technical and patient care skills.
	Ability to work effectively in a healthcare team.
	Strong attention to detail and accuracy.


Preferred Qualifications:


	1–3 years of experience in a hospital or diagnostic center and completion of internship and NYSC.
	Experience with multiple imaging modalities such as CT scans, ultrasound etc.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Maintain accurate records of imaging procedures and patient data.
	Ensure imaging equipment is regularly checked and maintained.
